title: Normalized QuickGO Concordance Matrix
description: Validation contract for comparative concordance analytics between source-native GO annotations and external QuickGO captures under scheme MFPB_QUICKGO_CONCORDANCE_V1. Enforces strict comparison unit (accession, source, aspect, policy), empty-set null conventions, deterministic diagnostic precedence, and non-double-counted Policy C exclusion metrics.

protein_id.description: Resolved catalog entity identifier from candidate v0.3.0 mfp_proteins.csv.

source_id.description: Canonical source catalog identifier (e.g. SRC_MOONPROT, SRC_MULTITASKPROTDB_II, SRC_PLANTMP).

policy_id.description: Concordance policy identifier (Policy B unfiltered inventory or Policy C filtered descriptive overlap).

source_inventory_status.description: Availability and completeness classification of source term inventory for this aspect.

quickgo_inventory_status.description: Availability and completeness classification of external QuickGO term inventory for this aspect.

source_terms_count.description: Count of distinct source GO terms for this aspect, or null if inventory is indeterminate or unavailable.

quickgo_terms_count.description: Count of distinct QuickGO terms for this aspect, or null if unlinked/absent/unavailable.

exact_overlap_count.description: Exact set intersection count |S ∩ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

union_terms_count.description: Exact set union count |S ∪ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

source_only_count.description: Source-only set difference count |S \ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

quickgo_only_count.description: QuickGO-only set difference count |Q \ S|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

jaccard_similarity.description: Jaccard similarity coefficient |S ∩ Q| / |S ∪ Q|, or null if non-evaluable.

concordance_status.description: Binary evaluability flag enforcing non-empty set and biological identity prerequisites.

primary_non_evaluable_reason.description: Governing diagnostic assigned by strict deterministic precedence, or null when evaluable.

secondary_non_evaluable_reasons.description: Semicolon-delimited list preserving all simultaneously observed diagnostic conditions, or null.

identity_review_status.description: Propagated identity comparability flag from coverage.

nd_matching_rows_count.description: Count of QuickGO rows matching evidence code 'ND' for this aspect under Policy C, or null under Policy B.

root_matching_rows_count.description: Count of annotation rows matching GO root terms for this aspect under Policy C, or null under Policy B.

nd_root_overlap_rows_count.description: Count of annotation rows matching both ND and root term for this aspect, or null under Policy B.

net_excluded_rows_count.description: Net unique excluded annotation rows (ND + root - overlap) under Policy C, or null under Policy B.

terms_lost_after_filtering_count.description: Distinct GO terms present in Policy B but completely eliminated under Policy C, or null under Policy B.

terms_retained_via_other_rows_count.description: Distinct non-root GO terms supported by at least one ND row that survived due to co-occurring eligible rows.

unassessed_evidence_rows_count.description: Count of source annotation rows for this aspect lacking explicit evidence codes (not classified as ND/non-ND).
